'''Kehel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Acolyte]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was seen at the entrance of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], talking with [[Nataya]] and [[Telo (Human)|Telo]].
